intro.fr: Time Rifters se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Time Rifters can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub johnny1754/TimeRifters-Archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de Time Rifters.
text.en: The GitHub repository johnny1754/TimeRifters-Archipelago, home of the Time Rifters APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.5.7 (préversion).
text.en: The first version, v0.5.7 (pre-release), is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v1.0.13, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (7 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v1.0.13 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (7 versions released).

text.fr: Time Rifters figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Time Rifters is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
